Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

  • Diplomacy / Pauses: Trump announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes. Deadline Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET. He says talks are "going very well." Iran denies any direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Military / Kinetic: IDF and Shin Bet report they killed a Hamas leader who held four hostages, including Cpt. Daniel Perez.
  • Previous 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. High risk of future violations.
  • Airspace & Transport: Airports closed in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan. Flight scans show large numbers of grounded aircraft. Civilian flights severely disrupted.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran reportedly permits passage for "friendly" states (Russia, India, China). Parliament speaker says Iran-Oman agreement based on US MoU.
  • Iran internal / Funeral: Khamenei laid in state. Week-long mass funeral events underway. Iran warned the US and Israel not to strike during the funeral period.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah and northern front active daily. Expect continued rocket/missile harassment and IDF responses.
  • Political / Territory: Israel approved plan for 13 new West Bank settlements. This adds diplomatic friction during pauses.
  • Other notable items: Multiple outlets report an Israeli plot to target top Iranian negotiators that the US allegedly prevented. Russia/Belarus rhetoric on mutual defense; monitor for deployments.
  • 🟢 Good News: Ten-day pause creates a short diplomatic window. US reportedly protected Iranian negotiators. IDF reports a successful counterterror operation.
  • Bottom line: Escalating.

  • International posture: Russia reiterates security guarantees with Belarus. Oil prices stable despite tensions.
  • Security actions at home: Arrests and security awards reported (IDF honors US air defense personnel; arrests of suspects in West Bank and Tel Aviv incidents).
  • 🟢 Good News: Pakistan mediation + US pause create a diplomatic opening. Regional airports and air defenses continue to limit civilian casualties so far.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
